blurb: Guests participate in aerial arts using apparatuses like silks and hammocks to climb, pose, and invert, combining dance, acrobatics, and yoga. Classes build strength, flexibility, endurance, and confidence, with options for beginners and advanced students, including youth classes. The studio provides a safe, supportive environment with certified instructors and various class formats including series, private lessons, and special events.
